newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 10-yr inflation note seen at 3.51 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 10-yr inflation note seen at 3.51 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury auction of $7.0 billion in 10-year inflation-indexed notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield between 3.51 and 3.52 percent above the variation of the consumer price index, dealers said.
At 1230 EST/1730 GMT, the 10-year notes were quoted at 3.5125 percent plus CPI in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
Traders said demand for the paper appeared to be solid. Pension and mutual funds, insurance firms and speculators are seen as potential buyers of the issue, they added.
